meaning:
ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Gen.44:21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Est.6:27, Pro.27:25, Sir.30:25, 1Ma.11:37 * ;]
to take care of: with genitive, Luk.10:34-35, 1Ti.3:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
(but how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule one’s own house take care of God’s assembly?)
